data.coverage: 31,509 applications opened in 2016; 1,202,267 events through February 1, 2017.

target.label: Restricted remaining time to first recorded Pending/Denied/Cancelled application status
target.estimand: Expected remaining discrete days capped at 30, among applications still active at the selected event prefix
target.prediction_cutoff: Only first 5,10 or20 application events; all related offers remain in the application split
target.horizon: 30 days with daily intervals; complete final-horizon ascertainment
target.unit: Application; multiple event prefixes remain clustered

cohort: December2016 application arrivals; eligible prefixes observed before January1,2017. Later source events are outcomes only.
uncertainty: 500 paired application-cluster bootstrap draws retain all evaluated prefixes of each application. Conditional on fitted models and one institutional/time cohort; no retraining uncertainty.
assumptions: The first Pending/Denied/Cancelled status is a defined workflow endpoint, not confirmed disbursement.
All final prefixes have at least30-day outcome ascertainment; longer times remain capped.
Lifecycle events are retained and elapsed gaps are not active service measurements.
Capacity changes are explicit proportional scenarios, not identified staffing effects.
limitations: One institution and one final arrival month; temporal generalization is not established.
Early prefixes may omit later loops; unavailable prefixes and already-dispositioned cases are excluded with counts.
All predictions and bands refer to a30-day restricted endpoint, not unrestricted remaining duration.
Repeated prefixes are dependent and treated as application clusters.
No resource-efficiency, causal automation, financial-saving or lending-decision claim is made.

tables.transition_scope: Consecutive application-stage events within the longest eligible final prefix per application; edges with fewer than30 occurrences omitted.

capacity_scenario.unit: hypothetical remaining days under proportional-time assumptions
capacity_scenario.interpretation: Scenario arithmetic, not a causal queueing/staffing estimate.
